result_summary.title: Mass account lockouts in Payment Gateway v2 (LATAM)
result_summary.description: We are receiving reports of widespread account lockouts affecting 737 users in the LATAM production region via Payment Gateway v2. Users cannot log in to their accounts to complete payments. The lockout appears to be happening immediately after login attempts. This is a high-impact issue stopping transactions. Please investigate the authentication mechanism or account status flags for these users.
